## Description and Rationale

We are a team of university students interested in data science and machine learning.

We joined this challenge because we wanted to use what we have learned in class on a real-world problem. We are excited to work with real aviation data, learn new skills, and improve our modeling skills together as a team.

## Details

* Type: Academia
* Country: Japan
* Number of team members: 2
